To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the wave front sets of direct integrals of singular, irreduci- ble representations of a real reductive algebraic Lie group are contained in the singular sets of the representations; (2) the wave front set is a natural tool for the analysis of the asymptotic behavior of the multiplicities of tempered representations in the direct integrals of irreducible representations in restriction and induction problems for real reductive Lie groups.

(1) the wave front set (WFS) of a representation is contained in the set of singular representations, and (2) if the WFS contains a singular representation, then that singular representation is in the set of representations with nontrivial WFS.

the wave front sets of the irreducible, unitary representations of a real reductive algebraic Lie group are contained in a union of the singular set and the set of points at which the representation has a non-trivial kernel.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following problem.
the wave front set and its relation to the asymptotic behavior of the Plancherel formula for real, reducible Lie groups.
the asymptotic behavior of the Plancherel measure of the unitary dual of a real, connected, reductive algebra.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the wave front sets of the representations occurring in the restriction and induction of a representation of a reductive group are contained in the singular sets.
the wave front sets of all irreducible unitary representations of reductive algebraic Lie groups have been determined.
the wave front sets of irreducible, tempered representations of real, reductive Lie groups are contained in the singular sets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown that the wave-front sets of the representations occurring in the Plancherel formula for real, reducible algebraic groups are determined by the wave-front sets for the representations in the Plancheral formula for the real, reductive subgroups.
the tempered representations of real, reductive groups are the only representations that occur asymptotically in the wave front set.
the singularities of the direct integral of irreducible representations are determined by the singularities of each irreducible representation.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we show that the wave front sets of irreducible representations of real, reductive groups are contained in their singular sets, which is a generalization of the results in [1] for semisimple Lie groups and in [2] for real reductive Lie algebras.
the singular set is the correct set on which to study the asymptotics of the Plancherel measure for real reductive Lie groups.
the wave front sets of irreducible representations are contained in the singular sets.
